data.narrative:
Thea Energy is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Brian Berzin that has raised $20M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a nuclear energy sector comp universe of 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, and Aalo Atomics.

Stage-progression analysis, the sole applicable triangulation method, applies a 1.9x multiplier to a $100M total-raised proxy, implying a $190M valuation. This reflects typical Series B to next-stage step-up dynamics within the nuclear energy sector. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables—while 4 same-sector peers exist, none met the threshold of 3+ datapoints within narrow valuation tiers necessary for reliable median derivation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $162M to $218M, centered on $190M. Key uncertainties include the limited granularity of applicable valuation methods (single method only) and the relatively sparse near-peer dataset in nuclear energy at Series B stage. A multi-method triangulation would strengthen conviction; additional comparable data on Series B nuclear companies or forward-looking metrics on technology maturity and regulatory pathway would refine the range.
